Priya Shah: quick follow-up from Friday's PM 10: three leftover actions: RED-5020 (kv-cache TTL audit), RED-5021 (runbook + alert), RED-5022 (post-deploy smoke). who can own? cc @Markus @Iris
Markus Vogel: I'll take RED-5020. plan: audit config across regions, propose unified TTL. ETA 10 business days. need read access to prod config.
Iris Tan: RED-5021 I'll own (runbook + alert). will add acceptance criteria and paging rule. target 3 days.
Ben Ortiz: small item RED-5022 I can do (smoke tests + rollout checklist). will coordinate with DevEx for QA env.
ops-bot: attached incident artifacts: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/pm/2024-05-03/artifacts.zip; created RED-5020 RED-5021 RED-5022 links.
Priya Shah: RACI suggestion: Markus = R/A for 5020, Iris = A for 5021, Ben = A for 5022, Priya = I. owners please add AC + rollback + test plan to Jira by EOD Wed.
Markus Vogel: added preliminary AC to RED-5020. requesting infra access; pinging @eng-infra.
Iris Tan: updated RED-5021 with runbook draft and alert thresholds. will add pager duties.
Ben Ortiz: opened RED-5022 with test harness link. scheduling a 1h pairing with DevEx Thu.
Priya Shah: created epic RED-801 to group these and to track recurring KV-cache pattern. also created RED-5023 (detection: signal pipeline eval) to Research.
Markus Vogel: note: if audit shows config drift, propose fast rollback and a hotfix to unify deploy pipeline. I'll flag in ticket.
Priya Shah: thanks everyone. recap: owners assigned, tickets updated, add AC+rollback+tests by Wed EOD. I'll follow up in ops review next Monday. :white_check_mark:
